verdict.rationale: Sumsub publishes a broad claim of covering '14,000+ document types from 220+ countries and territories' and describes verification levels including document-based checks, but the evidence pack lacks a documented published list/breakdown by specific document type (passports, national IDs, driver licenses, residence permits) per country. missing for 10: a searchable/published per-country per-document-type coverage list, independent verification of the 14,000+ document claim.
